scope: Read-only bounded inventory of prime-mlx-lab and pmhnp-companion-ergentics prime-runtime/content-staging. Safetensors headers and file metadata only; no weight payload hash, execution, training or app/user session logs. Later native English/Latin and Stage7 retained runs are inventoried separately by parent task.

generator.sequence_construction: BOS + NFC UTF-8 prompt + exact completion + EOS

nativeCompositionalCorpus.interpretation: Procedurally generated first-party compositional tasks, not an aggregate of all Ergentics repositories. Historical reports declare 135,168 training rows and 32,147,030 byte-token instances; each profile probe trained only 288 scheduled rows and 147,456 padded token positions over 36 steps. Corpus size is not actual training consumed.

currentCompanionByteTokenizer.historicalBindingCaution: Current manifest includes completion symbols 2/3 and EOS 70. Older canary report hashes identify historical manifests; do not replace those bindings using the shared tokenizer ID alone.

selectedSmallNativeResults.interpretation: Saved random-init symbolic model and measured learning; not natural-language chat. No fresh inference performed.

latestSmallMechanicsResult.interpretation: Engine-coupled 32/32 holdout differs from direct-neural 3/32 holdout; model training occurred on 112 fixed-symbol training rows.

olderLlamaLineage.interpretation: Llama 3.2-derived 3B with 128,256 vocabulary, distinct from the random-init native 512 byte-token model. Quantized storedElementCount counts packed arrays, not original model parameters. Prior task tested actual generation separately.

largeCoreMLExport.interpretation: A native Swift export pipeline for older Llama-based weights is not a new first-party model checkpoint. The 64-token CoreML single-shot export cap differs from the upstream 131,072-position config and later native 2,048 context. This audit did not load or compile this package and makes no current execution-readiness claim.

record.note: Wire v2 L8 skips in-session L9 when mil_weight catalog sidecar exists; inspector still sets contract_graph_detected on ship graph.

zeroLogitProbe.interpretation: An 852-byte zero-logit I/O test template exists. Emitter selects it for matching I/O when tail weights are incomplete. Recorded L9 witness used a shell copy and declared ship bytes untouched. This is not evidence that older fused MLX Llama generation or random-init native inference is hardcoded.

historicalBaselines.interpretation: Some filenames call smaller adapted models native; their explicit IDs identify Llama and Qwen inheritance. Product verifier 324/324 is separately classified from neural 180/250 control. These are saved historical evaluator numbers, not new measurements.

conclusions: Actual retained work spans symbolic 10.23M checkpoints, native 300M/1B/3B short profile probes, and older Llama-derived 3B weights/exports. No universal percentage of missing work can be measured from these roots alone.
Native 300M label corresponds to 271,107,072 parameters at vocab 512; 1B and 3B profile parameters were also actually instantiated. A 300M target alone is not established as the cause of bad answers.

The corrected profile screen did not establish a model-size winner. Only 36 steps and two independent confirmation replicates; no saved weights or generated answers in this campaign. Corpus availability and measured profile optimization are different facts.
Positive symbolic results are real but method-specific: trace curriculum 100% held-out autoregressive versus 6.25% direct one-shot; latest mechanics 100% engine-coupled versus 9.375% direct neural.
Repository discovery alone does not bind artifacts into a tokenizer, checkpoint or app route. Preserve exact data/tokenizer/weights bindings and expose each route explicitly.
